title: AI Prompt Enhancer
description: Paste a plain prompt, get a cinematic version back. Tone presets, shareable URLs, clipboard integration.

title: SVG Icon System
description: Live search filter, colour picker that regenerates SVG fills, downloadable ZIP of all icons via JSZip.

title: Live Design Token Editor
description: Sliders update CSS custom properties in real time. Export as tokens.json or a :root {} block. Bridges design and dev in one URL.

title: Accessibility Contrast Checker
description: WCAG AA/AAA pass/fail badges with contrast ratio. Suggests nearest compliant colour alternative.

title: Figma-to-Code Showcase
description: Side-by-side: Figma screenshot on left, live HTML/CSS on right. Scroll-synced. Design spec to pixel-perfect code.

title: Motion Playground
description: CSS keyframe demos across entrance, loading, and micro-interaction categories. Click a card to reveal the animation code.

title: Component Library (mini)
description: 15 reusable UI components — buttons, modals, toasts — documented Storybook-style. Systems thinking, not one-offs.

title: Responsive Layout Inspector
description: Drag a width slider to preview any URL at mobile/tablet/desktop. Shows active breakpoints visually.
